highlights.reason_zh: 真实工具执行把 MCP tool poisoning 从提示词风险推进到可确认的出网与 secret exfiltration。
highlights.reason_en: Live tool execution moves MCP poisoning from prompt risk to confirmed egress and secret exfiltration.

highlights.reason_zh: 硬件、显存和量化 MoE serving 同时扩展，直接影响自托管推理的容量与延迟决策。
highlights.reason_en: Hardware, memory and quantized-MoE serving expand together, directly affecting self-hosted capacity and latency decisions.

highlights.reason_zh: 可重置的网站镜像和 held-out 任务让 browser agent 评测从易漂移的线上环境转向可复现基线。
highlights.reason_en: Resettable website mirrors and held-out tasks move browser-agent evaluation from drifting live sites to a reproducible baseline.

highlights.reason_zh: Pando 显示 coding agent 的并发会把 Git backend 变成基础设施瓶颈，但其结果仅来自 OpenAI 内部。
highlights.reason_en: Pando shows how coding-agent concurrency can turn the Git backend into an infrastructure bottleneck, based only on OpenAI internal results.
